findings.detail: ACCEPTED DEVIATION (not a remaining blocker). Commit 19fe2ab ('fix: guard class-endeavour lookup against prototype-member class names') on this branch modifies EXISTING pure logic (src/logic/endeavours.ts buildPickerItems; src/logic/assistant/rules/downtime-recommendations.ts downtimeRecommendationSuggestions) and a PRE-EXISTING test helper (src/logic/assistant/rules/__tests__/downtime-recommendations.test.ts catalogFor), which belong to the prior downtime/endeavour task rather than guided disease/corruption, so the branch as a whole is not strictly additive. Independently verified: the change is a behavior-preserving Object.hasOwn prototype-pollution guard (valid class names unaffected; only junk strings colliding with Object.prototype members like '__proto__'/'constructor' change outcome from a crash to 'unmatched'), rulebook-cited (Core p.200-201), and the test edit is a helper-robustness mirror, not an assertion weakening. The user already explicitly accepted this as a documented cross-task hotfix and declined history rewriting on shared main (recorded in the prior convergence pass). Resolution: keep recorded as an accepted deviation; no further action required.
